title: report runs hold only human-readable reports, no json/log (REQ-0108)
acceptance_criteria: AC1 publish/report-pack write no .json except run.json and no .log under reports/; INDEX lists .md/.pdf/.tsv only; run.json names source plan runs and score
AC2 unit tests green; dgnl2026, dhqg2024 main re-published without json/log, old main runs deleted

design.summary: report runs stop writing metrics/result-data/score-summary json and run-log; kinds kept as needs=retired; provenance + score from run.json

implementation.summary: report_build/report_pack stop writing metrics, result-data, score-summary json and run-log; kinds needs=retired (score-summary json optional_ext for old runs); run.json score; _rl_score reads run.json first; checker counts stray json/log

user_notes.note: standing rule: report folders hold only human-readable files (md/pdf/tsv + INDEX.md, run.json); machine data stays in plans/

next: tester: add _rl_score run.json-first test, full suite
